title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics, schema mapping, and tool message formatting for function calling
author: Lina Chen
description: Motivation: Bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer for function/tool calling closer to OpenAI's semantics (tool_choice + schema mapping) and fix several message-formatting edge cases seen in streaming and structured-output clients. This PR implements: 1) tool_choice semantics: when the model returns a tool_choice selection we map it to Redwood's internal tool invocation flow and emit the compatible structured response; 2) schema mapping: support mapping external tool schemas (OpenAI-style JSON Schema + nested property hints) to our Tool Registry shape so tools can be discovered and validated at runtime; 3) message formatting: normalize tool invocation messages emitted by the compat layer to match OpenAI's JSON-within-message convention and avoid double-escaping during streaming; 4) backwards-compatibility: preserve existing Redwood tool invocations when running in native mode; 5) tests and integration: unit + integration tests for parsing, mapping, and streaming formatting, plus a small end-to-end test against the openai-compat harness. Checklist: - [x] Implement tool_choice mapping and handler - [x] Add schema mapper and validation helpers - [x] Normalize streaming message formatting and add sanitizer - [x] Update compat docs and examples - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Add Linear ticket references and link to test harness runtime How to review: focus on the schema mapper (schema_mapper.go) and the compat layer change (openai_compat.go). Pay attention to the streaming sanitizer diff which touches the streaming encoder. This change intentionally preserves legacy behavior when REDWOOD_OPENAI_COMPAT=false. Related work: ENG-1423 (tooling compat epic), ENG-1478 (streaming stability incident follow-up), PR #61234 (previous tool schema baseline). Notes: This description intentionally contains implementation rationale and compatibility guarantees.

release_notes: Adds OpenAI-compatible tool_choice semantics and schema mapping for function/tool calling. Normalizes compat-layer tool invocation message formatting for streaming clients. Backwards-compatible unless REDWOOD_OPENAI_COMPAT=true. Includes tests and docs.
notes: Compatibility: When REDWOOD_OPENAI_COMPAT=true the compat layer will translate OpenAI-style tool invocations (tool_choice + message content containing JSON) into Redwood Tool Registry calls. In native mode behavior is unchanged.
Performance: schema mapping happens at registration-time/cache-time to avoid per-request JSON Schema compilation costs. Mapping fallbacks included for unsupported schema features.
Testing: added unit tests for parsing, mapping, and streaming formatting. Integration test exercises round-trip with the openai-compat test harness.
